# LinguaBuddy

> > LinguaBuddy offers structured online language courses aligned with CEFR standards, specializing in Spanish instruction across proficiency levels.

LinguaBuddy provides multi-week language learning programs with scheduled online classes. The platform focuses on CEFR-aligned curriculum delivery, offering intermediate and advanced Spanish courses with consistent weekly scheduling to support progressive language acquisition.

## Key Topics

- LinguaBuddy
- CEFR (Common European Framework of Reference)
- Spanish B1 (Intermediate Spanish)
- Online language learning
- 12-week course structure
- Thursday classes
- Intermediate Spanish proficiency
- Structured language courses
- Weekly language instruction
- Spanish language education
